summary.intent: Resolve PR review comments and complete two pending todos: refactor api-client from singleton to instance-scoped axios, and investigate throttle bypass gaps in load tests.
summary.outcome: All PR review threads resolved, api-client fully migrated to instance-scoped axios (eliminating dual-path architecture), throttle bypass gap confirmed resolved, and IPFS calls migrated to use ctx.axiosInstance for consistency.

repo: The web app uses two call paths to the API: direct generated function imports (auth, shares, vault init, etc.) and CipherBoxClient-mediated calls (folder/file/bin ops). Phase 19.1 only rewired the latter.
BypassableThrottlerGuard.canActivate() returns true before super.canActivate(), so per-endpoint @Throttle decorators are fully bypassed when the header is present — no gap at the NestJS level.
IPFS controller uses only JwtAuthGuard with no throttle guard, so IPFS operations are not rate-limited.
The load test 429 errors were caused by parallel test suites hitting the live API simultaneously, not a code bug — running tests in isolation passes reliably.
sdk-core's ipfs/index.ts used bare axios.post() with manual token injection instead of the instance-scoped axios, missing 401 refresh handling.
Phase 19.1 roadmap shows '6/6 plans complete' but checkboxes were unchecked — the web app rewiring (Plan 19.1-05) was partial, covering only folder/file/bin but not auth/shares/vault/device ops.

code.finding: Refactored to support both singleton and instance-scoped paths. createAxiosInstance now handles 401 refresh. setApiClientConfig accepts optional pre-built instance. customInstance accepts optional _axiosInstance in options object to bypass singleton.
SdkContext gains optional axiosInstance field. AxiosInstance imported from @cipherbox/api-client re-export rather than dynamic import from axios, since sdk-core doesn't directly depend on axios.
CipherBoxClientConfig gains optional axiosInstance and defaultHeaders fields. Same import pattern needed — use @cipherbox/api-client re-export for AxiosInstance type.
createAndPublishIpnsRecord, batchPublishIpnsRecords, resolveIpnsRecord all accept optional ctx parameter to forward axiosInstance to generated API calls.
addToIpfs and unpinFromIpfs migrated from bare axios.post() with manual token injection to ctx.axiosInstance. fetchFromIpfs uses native fetch for streaming and remains unchanged.
Creates the single shared axios instance with auth interceptors and 401 refresh, registers it as singleton via setApiClientConfig, and exports it for CipherBoxClient consumption.
initSdkClient passes the shared axiosInstance from api-config into CipherBoxClientConfig, ensuring both direct API calls and SDK-mediated calls use the same instance.
Test assertions needed updating after ctx parameter was added — toHaveBeenCalledWith needed to include undefined as second arg for backward-compat calls.
loadBinMetadataInternal and saveBinMetadata called resolveIpnsRecord/createAndPublishIpnsRecord without forwarding ctx — discovered via grep after initial threading pass missed this file.

workflow: When threading a parameter through a call chain, always grep for ALL callers after the initial pass — it's easy to miss files like bin/index.ts that aren't in the primary call path being refactored.
curl -s returns exit code 0 even on HTTP 5xx; use curl -fsS in health check loops so server errors correctly fail readiness checks.
Dynamic import('axios') fails in packages that only have axios as a transitive dependency — use re-exports from direct dependencies instead.
Parallel pnpm test runs against a live API can trigger rate limiting (429s) that don't occur in isolation — always verify test failures in isolation before investigating as code bugs.

friction: Repeated 429 errors during pnpm test caused confusion about whether fixes were working — required multiple re-runs with cooldown delays to confirm tests actually passed.
AxiosInstance type import required indirect approach via @cipherbox/api-client re-export in both sdk and sdk-core packages, discovered only at typecheck time.
ipns.test.ts mock assertions broke silently after ctx parameter was added — the undefined second argument wasn't obvious from the test failure message.
bin/index.ts IPNS callers were missed in the initial threading pass and only caught via a final grep sweep, requiring an additional commit.
open_items: Web app still has 13 files importing directly from @cipherbox/api-client (auth, vault init, shares, invites, device approval, health checks, IPFS, IPNS) — these now use the shared instance but could eventually be migrated to go through CipherBoxClient methods.
fetchFromIpfs uses native fetch for streaming and manually injects auth token — not migrated to ctx.axiosInstance; worth revisiting if 401 refresh is needed on IPFS downloads.
Phase 19.1 roadmap checkboxes are unchecked despite the work being complete — roadmap needs to be updated to reflect actual completion status.
E2E tests were not run after the refactor (only typecheck and unit tests) — SDK E2E suite should be run to confirm no regressions in the full auth/upload/share flow.
